author: Ian Robinson
text: I had Palmetto Septic Solutions pump the septic tank at my mother‘s house. They did a fantastic job, the Price was great and I would highly recommend to anybody!

author: Gigi Garzon
text: I can’t say enough good things about Gregory and his team at Palmetto Septic Systems! They responded promptly to our septic issue and were professional, knowledgeable, and efficient from start to finish. Their staff communicated extremely well throughout the process, which I especially appreciated because this was a time-sensitive issue involving my spa. I was very happy with the service and quality of their work. Thank you again, Gregory and team! Highly recommend!

author: Larry Houck
text: Had my septic tank pumped. They were very professional and knowledgeable and answered all the questions I had when I was just curious without hesitation. I picked them based off reviews. Could be a bit pricey but you pay for the correct and professional service so it what it is. Thank you all.

author: deangelo hayward
text: They came out and got the job done in no time. I would highly recommend using their services!

author: Sally Zac
text: Very satisfied.  Price was good.  They came out and were  honest, polite and very knowledgeable.  Did a great job and gave very good information regarding the size of my septic tank vs household size, as well as, plumbing information.  I definitely recommend going with company.
